pages.text: That's all four.$(br2)They won't hold together on their own. They need something to bind them, a heart that's never gone cold, and there's only one of those I know of. It's in the dragon.
Put the eyes in the frame and go through. Then bring every piece together and make it whole.$(br2)$(o)The last thing you need is still beating inside the Ender Dragon, in the End.$()
